target_distribution.positive_incident_queries: 35 queries (70%) spanning IT Act 2000, BNS 2023, and pre-July 2024 IPC 1860 offenses
target_distribution.out_of_scope_no_match_queries: 15 queries (30%) spanning civil contract, landlord-tenant, consumer disputes, IP/trademark, and lawful daily activities

sampling_requirements: Realistic natural-language incident phrasing reflecting layperson complainant vocabulary
Strict avoidance of statutory provision titles, section numbers, or verbatim legal definitions
Clear chronological markers when distinguishing between IPC 1860 (pre-1 July 2024) and BNS 2023 (post-1 July 2024)
Fact patterns must explicitly satisfy or negate requisite legal elements (e.g., gender criteria in BNS S78, dishonest inducement in S318)

dual_annotation_protocol.minimum_inter_annotator_agreement: Cohen's Kappa >= 0.80 on binary provision relevance
dual_annotation_protocol.adjudication: Mandatory senior legal adjudicator review for any label, element, or scope disagreement
dual_annotation_protocol.provenance_tracking: Each reviewed query must record primary annotator, secondary reviewer, and legal adjudicator (if escalated)

isolation_and_independence_rules: Strict physical and logical separation from development training and threshold selection pipelines
Zero exposure to min_score (tau) calibration sweeps or retrieval ranking parameter searches
Zero inspection of retrieval candidate scores or rankings prior to official locked evaluation run
Pairwise token Jaccard similarity must be strictly < 0.50 against all dev and exploratory test queries
Upon completion and verification, dataset must be cryptographically locked with SHA-256 registered in benchmark_manifest.json

fields.query_text: string (Realistic incident description in complainant words)
fields.relevant_provision_ids: array of strings (verified provision IDs from legal_provisions.json; empty if expected_no_match=true)
fields.expected_no_match: boolean (true if incident is outside indexed penal/cyber provisions)
fields.legal_elements_verified: array of strings (substantive legal elements satisfied by the incident facts)
fields.rationale: string (statutory legal reasoning linking incident facts to provision elements)
fields.annotation_status: string ('pending' during drafting/review, 'reviewed' only after dual-review and adjudication)
fields.adjudicator_id: string or null (senior legal adjudicator for resolving ambiguities)
fields.unresolved_ambiguity: string or null (statutory or interpretative open questions requiring judicial clarification)
fields.locked: boolean (false during draft/collection, true upon cryptographic lock)
